stop_rules.stop_if: raw logs, session JSONL, screenshots, cache dumps, credential-bearing material, or private traces enter publishable artifacts or staging
stop_rules.action: unstage/abort publication and isolate as non-curated material
unstage unrelated files; do not broad stage

stop_rules.stop_if: Google Drive, GitHub connector, Gmail, Calendar, cloud, deployment, or desktop mutation is implied without separate scoped approval
delete, purge, cache cleanup, worktree cleanup, Drive cleanup, or repo cleanup is requested without a fresh explicit target list
sibling advisory is framed as proof, publication authority, independent validation, or live execution evidence
stop_rules.action: downgrade to advisory and record evidence boundary

stop_rules.stop_if: public claim lacks source authority or source role
THOS report is framed as GMUT validation, gate closure, final physics, consciousness proof, or fifth-force safety
stop_rules.action: block publication until language is corrected

stop_rules.stop_if: paid external action is uncertain or approaches $100 ceiling
stop_rules.action: stop and request a new packet
